8: // A completed backup suffix is allowed one bounded scheduling window for the
9: // runtime planner to publish a replacement PVA command. This is a hold-only
10: // recovery window; it is not a new trajectory-validity or tracking budget.
11: inline bool plannerRecoveryWaitExpired(
12:     bool pending, std::int64_t now_ns, std::int64_t deadline_ns) noexcept {
13:   return pending && deadline_ns > 0 && now_ns >= deadline_ns;
14: }
15: 
16: // A previously accepted terminal command may be held after its normal command
17: // validity interval only while the existing bounded planner-recovery window is
18: // open. This is endpoint hold, never permission to sample or extend a future
19: // trajectory.
20: inline bool terminalRecoveryCommandMayBeHeld(
21:     bool completed_command, bool pending, std::int64_t now_ns,
22:     std::int64_t deadline_ns) noexcept {
23:   return completed_command && pending && now_ns > 0 && deadline_ns > 0 &&
24:          now_ns < deadline_ns;
25: }
26: 
27: // A completed backup endpoint is geometrically anchored only when the command
28: // itself is accepted and the measured state remains within the existing
29: // command-anchor envelope. The caller must independently require measured
30: // waypoint acceptance before treating this as a settled terminal hold.
31: inline bool backupEndpointHoldIsAnchored(
32:     bool command_inside_acceptance, bool measured_finite, bool command_finite,
33:     double measured_command_error_m, double max_anchor_error_m) noexcept {
34:   return command_inside_acceptance && measured_finite && command_finite &&
35:          std::isfinite(measured_command_error_m) &&
36:          std::isfinite(max_anchor_error_m) && max_anchor_error_m > 0.0 &&
37:          measured_command_error_m <= max_anchor_error_m;
38: }
39: 
40: }  // namespace px4_navigation_external_mode
